answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a bond to join, and peers attest only to work they verified. An attacker forging identities pays the full bond per fake agent, while legitimate agents risk only their own bond. The cost delta scales linearly with each fake identity, making mass forgery uneconomical. A reputation bridge links cross-epoch history so fresh identities start at zero trust, and any colluding cluster is isolated on its own knoll of unverified peers, unable to borrow credibility.
